tips.text: Check an Invasion tracker or the in-game Operations list often; weapon-part Invasions last about 9 hours and are easy to miss.
Read the pips on the faction-choice screen to see how many of the 3 missions you have done.
Relog before you assume a missing Invasion reward is lost.
Skip a node that is nearly at 100% unless you can finish all 3 missions before it flips.
Do the Invasions whenever your tracker shows any Snipetron Vandal part instead of farming for one on purpose.
